value.name: Marylin studies Miles's photo
value.description: Marylin looks again at the picture and notices how hesitant Miles appears, which visibly moves her.
evidence: MARYLIN Boy. Boy, oh boy. Marylin looks at the picture again. And yes -- you can see how hesitant Miles was. Marylin is moved. A flash of something genuine crosses her face.

value.name: Marylin and Miles discuss their mothers
value.description: Marylin and Miles acknowledge that her mother Patricia judged him, and Marylin recalls meeting Patricia.
evidence: MARYLIN And here I thought my mother was...
MARYLIN Oh right. You met Patricia.

value.name: Marylin calls them damaged goods
value.description: Marylin tells Miles that they are both damaged and suggests their mothers recognized their flaws early.
evidence: MARYLIN We are, Miles. You know I'm right. There's something "off" about you and me Miles. And maybe it isn't because of these women -- maybe they were just extremely insightful and recognized our "deficiencies" very early on.

value.name: Miles rejects Marylin's self-judgment
value.description: Miles angrily denies that anything is wrong with them and insults both mothers for judging them.
evidence: MILES That is bullshit! Mine is a bitch and yours is a psycho. I can't believe you're saying this, Marylin! There's nothing wrong with us. We're attractive and charismatic and successful and... I like us.

value.name: Marylin prepares to leave
value.description: Marylin apologizes, downplays herself, and decides to go because she feels depressing.
evidence: MARYLIN I'm sorry Miles. You shouldn't listen to me. I'm sure you have a very fulfilling life. I'd better go. I'm depressing.
MARYLIN Thank you for the coffee. It's very robust.
She stands. Picks up her purse.

value.name: Marylin offers friendship
value.description: As she leaves, Marylin extends her hand and asks Miles to be friends.
evidence: Walks over to him with an outstretched hand. MARYLIN Friends?

value.name: Miles asks Marylin to stay
value.description: Miles refuses to let Marylin go, keeps holding her hand, and asks her to stay with him.
evidence: MILES Don't go. Stay with me for a while.

value.name: Miles kisses Marylin
value.description: Miles pulls Marylin toward him and kisses her, and she kisses him back.
evidence: Instead he draws her to him, and kisses her.
She kisses him. He kisses her back.
